nodes.name: Webhook Gather
nodes.notes: Twilio posts SpeechResult here. Query: call_id.

nodes.name: Claude Reply
nodes.notes: Anthropic header-auth credential. Put SYSTEM_PROMPT+OBJECTION_PLAYBOOK in $env.ALGORIXE_SYSTEM_PROMPT or paste inline.

nodes.name: Persist Turns
nodes.notes: UPDATE transcripts SET turns = $json.turns WHERE call_id = $json.call_id

parameters.responseBody: =<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Response><Gather input="speech" action="{{ $env.N8N_PUBLIC_URL }}/webhook/gather?call_id={{ $('Extract Reply').item.json.call_id }}" method="POST" speechTimeout="auto" speechModel="phone_call" language="en-US"><Say voice="Polly.Joanna-Neural">{{ $('Extract Reply').item.json.reply }}</Say></Gather></Response>
